text:
maria: ok team, quick sync — we need to finalize the design partner invite flow and the minimum feedback loop for the upcoming beta. goal: 10 partners, launch window 6 weeks.
aj: timeline sounds tight but doable if recruitment starts this week. what's the minimum criteria?
leo: suggest 1) integration proof-of-concept, 2) at least one real use-case meeting our latency/cost targets, 3) a contact willing to do weekly check-ins.
priya: +1. also ask for a short NDA sign-off and a single technical contact. keeps legal light.
maria: agreed. Draft screening form idea below — can someone sanity-check?
priya: put it here and I'll copy to Typeform.
maria: ```
- Company name
- Product area/use-case (1-2 sentences)
- Expected monthly requests (tokens or reqs)
- Is this for PII/regulatory data? (Y/N)
- Preferred deployment: hosted / dedicated / private
- Will you run a short integration (1 dev, 2 weeks)? Y/N
- Point of contact + Slack/email
```
leo: clean. add: "What is your SLO for 95th pct latency?" helps prioritize Dedicated trials.
aj: Also add a checkbox: "Willing to be recorded during feedback session" for usability notes.
maria: good call. ops-bot: new form created at https://forms.redwood/screening-189 / responses -> #dp-intake.
ops-bot: reminder: set form to collect timestamps and consent.
sam_k: recruitment channels: existing early-access list, outreach to 20 targeted accounts, and a blog post. we can split 10 invites from list, 10 targeted.
priya: for incentives, recommend $2k credit + 1:1 technical support + early feature requests. keeps commitment high.
maria: success criteria proposal:
- 10 active partners with integrations running
- At least 6 providing weekly feedback for 4 weeks
- Measured improvement on one key metric (latency or cost) or validated feature request
- No Sev1 stability regressions tied to rollout
aj: add acceptance criteria for rollout: sign-off from eng-runtime, security review completed, and a rollback plan documented.
leo: scope negotiation with partners: offer "integration sandbox" first (minimal API), then phased access to advanced features (batching, private routing) based on feedback.
priya: we should time-box feature asks: anything not shipped within 3 sprints goes into backlog with a clear communication plan.
maria: what about the feedback loop mechanics? proposing weekly 30m calls + an async Trello board for tickets + one recorded demo at midpoint.
sam_k: +1, and require partners tag their bugs with environment (hosted/dedicated/private). helps triage.
aj: can we instrument an automated evaluation? e.g., daily evals on a small prompt set to catch quality regressions.
leo: we have Redwood-eval harness ready; need partners' consent. also set alert if BLEU/ROUGE drops > 5% or hallucination rate spikes.
maria: negotiation talk-track for partners: emphasize low-effort onboarding, credits, direct product influence, and limited time commitment (6 weeks). keep expectations explicit.
priya: legal: simple DPAs + one-page scope annex. I can draft.
ops-bot: calendar slots available: week of 1891240000 for onboarding.
maria: next steps: priya to draft form, leo to add latency question + eval consent, aj to draft invite email, sam_k to prep outreach list. sync Fri 10am.
aj: I'll draft the invite copy and ping for quick review before send.
leo: I'll add the eval consent text in the form.
priya: I'll draft NDA+DPA and publish to shared drive.
sam_k: outreach list ready, will prioritize companies that matched our cost-sensitive profiles.
maria: thanks all — aim to send first wave by EOD Friday. :rocket:
